host_groups.description: List of host groups to monitor; each group contains one or more hosts

name.description: Name of the host group (used internally as ID)

hosts.description: List of hostnames or IPs in the group

services.description: List of services to monitor on hosts; each service specifies host, type, and checks

retry_interval.description: Interval before retrying a failed check

max_attempts.description: Number of failures before declaring a service down

args.description: List of arguments to pass to the service check (e.g., port for tcp)

alert.description: Name of the alert rule to use on failure

escalate.description: Name of escalation rule to invoke after multiple failures

alerts.description: List of alert actions triggered on service/host failures

command.description: Command to execute for 'exec' alerts (required if type=exec)

message.description: Custom message body for 'exec' or 'log' alerts

logfile.description: Path to log file for 'log' alerts

mon_user.description: User account under which the mon daemon runs

mon_group.description: Group account under which the mon daemon runs

libdir.description: Directory containing mon service check executables

pidfile.description: Path to PID file for the mon daemon

poll_interval.description: Interval (seconds) for re-evaluating the entire config and host states

status_interval.description: Interval (seconds) for generating status output files (e.g., status.html)

www_port.description: Port for the built-in HTTP status server

www_auth.description: Auth method for status page: 'none', 'basic', or 'digest'
